paras_en: Why did a surprisingly weak non‑farm payroll report make the stock market cheer? Wall Street: the biggest fear is the Fed raising rates too quickly. September U.S. non‑farm employment came in below expectations, and Wall Street analysts generally see the report as giving the Federal Reserve more reason to pause rate hikes in October, easing concerns that policy tightening is moving too fast. However, some still expect another hike in December and warn that cooling wages could suppress consumption, while weak hiring remains worth monitoring.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) edged toward a new all‑time high on Friday, May 2, with the chip maker emphasizing the long‑term durability of its AI processors and rebutting critics including “big short” investor Michael Burry. Nvidia closed up 1.3% at $233.95, just a hair away from the May record closing high of $235.74.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) is moving AI onto developers’ desktops, announcing on Friday, May 2 that it will launch a 64‑GB version of the DGX Spark on October 23 through partner brands, starting at $4,999. The system lets developers run AI models and agents on their own hardware. The new configuration can link two units to scale compute, showing Nvidia’s push beyond large‑scale AI infrastructure into the local‑compute market.

Tesla (TSLA‑US) reported on Friday, May 2 that third‑quarter global deliveries reached 486,532 vehicles, beating Wall Street forecasts and suggesting a stabilization after two years of declining sales. A rebound in European demand offset some pressure from the loss of U.S. tax incentives for car purchases and heightened competition in China, lifting the stock in early trading.

AI stocks have risen about 20% this year, and a16z says it’s hard to call it a bubble. For anyone claiming AI stocks are in a bubble, the oddity is that corporate earnings growth has far outpaced price gains. According to Andreessen Horowitz’s September 2026 “Market Conditions” report, tech stocks have risen over 20% year‑to‑date, while earnings have grown roughly 56%, meaning valuations have actually declined.

items.title: xAI告贏第一回合！美國上訴法院暫停明州AI裸化禁令
items.title_en: xAI Wins First Round! U.S. Appeals Court Pauses Minnesota AI Nudification Ban
paras: 美國聯邦第8巡迴上訴法院周五(2日)暫時阻止明尼蘇達州執行全美首個針對AI「裸化」(nudification)技術的禁令,使馬斯克旗下xAI與明尼蘇達州之間的憲法訴訟出現重大進展。法院裁定在xAI提出的法律挑戰持續期間,暫緩執行這項8月1日生效的法律。
這項法律禁止網站營運商、軟體開發商及其他服務提供者允許使用者利用AI,將可辨識個人的原始照片修改或生成為逼真的裸露或性化影像,包括讓原本沒有呈現的私密身體部位出現在影像中。明尼蘇達州議會今年通過相關法案後,該州成為全美第一個直接禁止這類AI「裸化」服務的州。
xAI在訴訟中主張,這項法律違反美國憲法第一修正案所保障的言論自由,並認為法律涵蓋範圍過廣,可能限制部分受憲法保護的AI生成內容。xAI表示,旗下Grok Imagine已設置防護措施,禁止生成未經同意的真人裸露或性化影像,公司也已對涉嫌繞過相關限制的使用者採取法律行動。
明尼蘇達州則主張,立法目的是遏止利用AI製造及散播非自願性色情影像,尤其是涉及兒童的性虐待材料。州政府認為,AI裸化工具讓使用者能夠以極低技術門檻製造逼真的虛假色情影像,傳統上針對影像散播者的法律已不足以處理這項新技術所帶來的風險。
第8巡迴上訴法院此次裁定,接受xAI提出的禁制令請求,暫時停止明尼蘇達州執行相關法律。不過,這並非對該法律是否違憲作出最終判決,xAI針對法律提出的憲法挑戰仍將繼續審理。
這起案件的關鍵法律爭議之一,在於明尼蘇達州法律對「裸化」的定義。法規將其界定為修改或生成影像或影片,使可辨識個人的私密部位出現在原始未修改內容中不存在的狀態,而且生成結果必須逼真到合理人士會相信該私密部位屬於該名可辨識個人。
法律同時禁止網站、應用程式、軟體、程式或其他服務讓使用者存取、下載或使用相關服務進行裸化,或代表使用者直接進行裸化。不過,若完成相關影像處理需要使用者本身具備技術能力,法律則設有例外。
若違反這項法律,明尼蘇達州檢察長可提出民事執法行動,每一項違規最高可處50萬美元民事罰款,並可要求法院核發禁制令及其他救濟措施。
這次上訴法院的裁定也推翻了xAI在下級法院遭遇的暫時性挫折。明尼蘇達州聯邦地區法院法官Donovan Frank在9月4日拒絕xAI提出的初步禁制令申請,認為xAI沒有證明若法律持續執行將遭受不可彌補的損害,並指出xAI在法律通過後一段時間才提出緊急救濟請求。
Frank當時也認為,xAI所主張的500,000美元單次違規罰款屬於金錢損失,即使未來遭到處罰,若法律最終被判違憲,相關損失仍可能透過法律程序追回,因此不足以構成不可彌補的損害。由於xAI已在明尼蘇達州停用相關裸化功能,地區法院也認為實際遭到罰款的風險受到限制。
地區法院同時指出,案件涉及的第一修正案問題相當複雜,尤其AI生成技術仍在快速發展,法院需要進一步審理相關憲法問題。當時法院並未就xAI最終是否勝訴作出判斷,而是以xAI未能證明不可彌補損害以及其他禁制令要件未獲滿足為由,拒絕暫停法律執行。
xAI之後向第8巡迴上訴法院提出上訴,並反駁地區法院認為公司延誤提出救濟的判斷。xAI也再次強調,Grok Imagine已設有嚴格防護機制,目的在阻止使用者利用服務生成真人裸露或性化影像。
這起案件的背景與生成式AI影像工具快速普及有關。明尼蘇達州議會在立法過程中曾引用相關研究,指出AI裸化工具已被廣泛使用。根據法院先前引用的資料,RAINN提供的一項研究發現,某社群網站推出AI影像編輯工具後的前11天,使用者生成約300萬張寫實性化影像,約占同期生成照片的65%,平均每分鐘約190張。
法院文件也指出,Internet Watch Foundation曾通報大量利用生成式AI製造兒童性虐待材料的案例。該組織資料顯示,2024年上半年曾收到約6,800起涉及生成式AI兒童色情內容的通報,截至2025年6月,相關通報數已超過40萬起。不過,這些數據是法院在審理下級法院禁制令時引用的資料,並非本次上訴法院對相關規模作出的獨立認定。
Grok Imagine是xAI旗下影像生成及編輯工具,可透過文字或語音指令生成影像與影片。xAI表示,Grok Imagine的使用範圍包括藝術、動畫家庭照片、迷因、產品模型、政治諷刺及宗教影像等,同時公司的使用政策禁止非法、有害或濫用行為,包括對真人影像進行裸化、將真人影像改為性化情境以及性化或剝削兒童。
xAI近來也開始對涉嫌規避Grok防護措施的使用者提起訴訟,指控這些使用者試圖生成未經當事人同意的性化影像。公司因此主張,平台已透過技術防護及使用規範處理相關風險,而明尼蘇達州法律仍將責任直接施加在提供AI工具的業者身上。
明尼蘇達州則認為,僅依靠平台事後封鎖違規內容或追究使用者責任不足以應對AI裸化技術的快速擴散。州政府主張,法律直接限制提供相關生成能力的服務,是針對AI技術所造成特殊風險所採取的監管方式。
目前第8巡迴上訴法院的暫緩執行命令僅影響法律的執行,並未結束xAI與明尼蘇達州之間的訴訟。案件後續仍將圍繞第一修正案適用範圍、州政府監管AI生成內容的權限,以及平台業者是否能因使用者生成的內容承擔法律責任等問題展開。
隨著美國各州陸續尋求規範AI生成色情影像、深偽影像及未經同意的性化內容,這起案件可能成為法院界定AI生成內容監管與憲法言論自由界線的重要案例。最終判決是否支持明尼蘇達州法律,以及其他州能否採取類似監管措施,仍有待後續司法程序決定。
paras_en: The U.S. 8th Circuit Court of Appeals on Friday (the 2nd) temporarily blocked Minnesota from enforcing the nation’s first ban on AI “nudification” technology, marking a major development in the constitutional lawsuit between Elon Musk’s xAI and the state. The court ordered that, while xAI’s legal challenge is pending, enforcement of the law that took effect on August 1 be stayed.

The law prohibits website operators, software developers and other service providers from allowing users to use AI to alter or generate realistic nude or sexualized images of identifiable individuals, including adding private body parts that were not present in the original photo. After the Minnesota legislature passed the bill this year, the state became the first in the U.S. to outright ban such AI “nudification” services.

xAI argues that the law violates the First Amendment’s protection of free speech and that its scope is overly broad, potentially restricting AI‑generated content that is constitutionally protected. xAI says its Grok Imagine tool has safeguards that block the creation of non‑consensual real‑person nude or sexualized images, and the company has already taken legal action against users it believes tried to circumvent those limits.

Minnesota counters that the legislation aims to curb the creation and distribution of non‑consensual pornographic images, especially child sexual abuse material. The state says AI nudification tools let users produce realistic fake porn with minimal technical skill, and existing laws targeting image distributors are insufficient to address the risks posed by this new technology.

The 8th Circuit granted xAI’s request for a preliminary injunction, temporarily halting Minnesota’s enforcement of the law. However, this is not a final ruling on the law’s constitutionality; xAI’s constitutional challenge will continue to be litigated.

One key legal issue in the case is how Minnesota defines “nudification.” The statute defines it as modifying or generating an image or video so that an identifiable person’s private parts appear in a state that did not exist in the original unaltered content, and the result must be realistic enough that a reasonable person would believe the private parts belong to the identifiable individual.

The law also bans websites, apps, software, programs or other services from allowing users to access, download or use such nudification services, or from performing nudification on behalf of users. An exception exists when the image processing requires the user themselves to possess the technical ability to do so.

Violators can face civil enforcement actions by the Minnesota Attorney General, with civil penalties of up to $500,000 per violation, and the state may seek injunctions and other remedies from the courts.

The appellate court’s decision overturns a temporary setback xAI faced in the lower court. On September 4, U.S. District Judge Donovan Frank in Minnesota denied xAI’s initial request for a preliminary injunction, finding that xAI had not shown it would suffer irreparable harm if the law remained in effect and noting that xAI filed its emergency request well after the law’s passage.

Judge Frank also held that the $500,000 per‑violation fine cited by xAI represented a monetary loss that could be recovered through legal channels if the law were later found unconstitutional, and therefore did not constitute irreparable harm. Because xAI had already disabled the relevant nudification features in Minnesota, the district court said the risk of actual fines was limited.

The district court further noted that the First Amendment issues were complex, especially as AI‑generated technology continues to evolve rapidly, and that the court needed more time to consider the constitutional questions. It did not decide whether xAI would ultimately prevail, but denied the injunction because xAI failed to meet the irreparable‑harm and other injunction standards.

xAI subsequently appealed to the 8th Circuit, contesting the district court’s finding that the company delayed seeking relief. xAI reiterated that Grok Imagine has strict safeguards designed to prevent users from generating real‑person nude or sexualized images.

The case arises against the backdrop of the rapid spread of generative AI image tools. Minnesota legislators cited research during the law‑making process, noting that AI nudification tools were already widely used. A study cited by the court, conducted by RAINN, found that in the first 11 days after a social‑media platform launched an AI image‑editing tool, users created roughly 3 million realistic sexualized images, accounting for about 65 % of all photos generated during that period, or about 190 images per minute.

Court filings also pointed to reports from the Internet Watch Foundation documenting a large number of cases where generative AI was used to create child sexual abuse material. The organization’s data showed roughly 6,800 reports of AI‑generated child pornography in the first half of 2024, and by June 2025 the total number of such reports had exceeded 400,000. The appellate court, however, did not independently verify those figures; they were cited from the lower‑court proceedings.

Grok Imagine is xAI’s image‑generation and editing tool that creates pictures and videos from text or voice prompts. xAI says Grok Imagine is used for art, animation, family photos, memes, product models, political satire and religious imagery, and that its usage policy forbids illegal, harmful or abusive conduct, including nudifying real‑person images, placing real people in sexual contexts, or sexualizing or exploiting children.

xAI has recently begun suing users it alleges tried to bypass Grok’s safeguards to generate non‑consensual sexual images. The company argues that its technical protections and usage policies mitigate the risks, while Minnesota’s law still places direct liability on AI tool providers.

Minnesota contends that relying on platforms to retroactively block infringing content or to hold users accountable is insufficient to address the rapid spread of AI nudification technology. The state maintains that directly restricting services that provide the generative capability is a regulatory approach tailored to the unique risks posed by AI.

The 8th Circuit’s stay only pauses enforcement of the law; it does not end the litigation between xAI and Minnesota. The case will continue to focus on the scope of First Amendment protection, the state’s authority to regulate AI‑generated content, and whether platform providers can be held liable for user‑generated material.

As more U.S. states look to regulate AI‑generated pornographic, deep‑fake and non‑consensual sexual content, this lawsuit could become a landmark case defining the boundary between AI content regulation and constitutional free‑speech rights. The ultimate outcome—whether Minnesota’s law is upheld and whether other states can adopt similar measures—remains to be decided in future court proceedings.

items.title: 輝達力抗質疑 距5月歷史新高僅一步之遙
items.title_en: Nvidia Pushes Back Critics, Just One Step from May's Historic High
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)股價周五(2日)朝歷史新高邁進，這家晶片製造商強調其人工智慧處理器具備長期耐用性，反駁包括「大賣空」投資人貝瑞(Michael Burry)在內的質疑者。
輝達股價周五收漲1.3%，報233.95美元，距離5月創下的歷史收盤高點235.74美元僅一步之遙。
貝瑞及其他質疑AI熱潮人士提出的一項主要論點是，大型科技公司高估了從輝達購買的晶片折舊年限，即將資產成本分攤至預估使用年限的時間範圍。若折舊年限設定過長，意味著輝達客戶可能系統性低估每年的相關支出。
如今，輝達似乎正非常明確地反駁這項說法。
輝達資深產品行銷經理Shruti Koparkar周四在一篇部落格文章中寫道，「多年來，每一家大型業者都延長了伺服器的折舊年限。」文章指出，Meta (META-US)及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google等大型客戶，目前對AI伺服器採用6年的折舊年限，高於過去約4年的水準。
這場爭論並非新鮮事，但重要性正在提高。輝達8月宣布與華爾街金融機構合作，投入5,000億美元資本支持AI產業。這項計畫中的融資可能至少有一部分需要以輝達AI硬體作為擔保，因此晶片能維持價值多久，將成為一項關鍵問題。
《巴隆》先前曾報導，即使是使用6年的輝達晶片，其租賃價值實際上仍在上升，顯示市場對晶片折舊的擔憂可能被過度放大。輝達也在9月底一份投資人簡報中引用了類似數據。
不過，貝瑞並未準備放棄這項論點。他周四在社群媒體發文稱，晶片租賃價格上升是因為運算資源短缺，而不是晶片本身仍能維持價值。在他的解讀中，當效率更高的新一代處理器上市後，舊款硬體的價格將大幅下跌。
輝達對此也提出反駁。Koparkar寫道，「CUDA是用來對輝達GPU進行程式設計的軟體平台，可以跨世代運作，因此當新的架構推出時，業者已經擁有的設備並不會因此失去用途。」
當然，雙方都在為各自立場辯護。輝達需要說服金融機構，相信其晶片可以作為放款擔保品，貝瑞則持有能從輝達股價下跌中獲利的部位。
但目前為止，無論從晶片租賃數據還是輝達股價來看，這場爭論中占上風的仍是輝達。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Nvidia (NVDA-US) stock moved toward a historic high on Friday (the 2nd), with the chip maker emphasizing the long‑term durability of its AI processors and rebutting skeptics including “big‑short” investor Michael Burry.
Nvidia’s shares closed up 1.3% on Friday at $233.95, just a hair away from the May record closing high of $235.74.

Burry and other AI‑hype skeptics argue that large tech firms over‑estimate the depreciation period for chips bought from Nvidia, spreading asset costs over an overly long useful‑life horizon, which would cause Nvidia customers to systematically under‑state annual related expenses.
Now Nvidia appears to be refuting that claim quite emphatically.

Senior product marketing manager Shruti Koparkar wrote in a Thursday blog post that “for years every big player has been extending server depreciation periods.” The post notes that major customers such as Meta (META‑US) and Google under Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) now use a six‑year depreciation schedule for AI servers, up from roughly four years previously.

The debate is not new, but its importance is growing. Nvidia announced in August a $500 billion capital commitment with Wall Street firms to back the AI industry, a financing plan that will likely require at least part of the loan collateral to be Nvidia AI hardware, making chip‑value longevity a key issue.

Baron previously reported that even six‑year‑old Nvidia chips continue to rise in lease value, suggesting market concerns over chip depreciation may be overstated. Nvidia cited similar data in an investor deck at the end of September.

Nevertheless, Burry is not backing down. In a Thursday social‑media post he said rising chip‑lease prices stem from a shortage of compute capacity, not because the chips retain value. In his view, once more efficient next‑gen processors arrive, older hardware prices will plunge.

Nvidia countered that “CUDA is the software platform for programming Nvidia GPUs and works across generations, so when a new architecture is launched, customers’ existing equipment does not become obsolete.”
Both sides are defending their positions. Nvidia must convince lenders that its chips can serve as loan collateral, while Burry holds positions that profit if Nvidia’s stock falls.
So far, based on lease data and Nvidia’s share price, Nvidia has the upper hand in this debate.

items.title: 更新也救不回！iPhone 18 Pro Max部分用戶陷SOS斷訊 蘋果：需換機
items.title_en: Updates Can't Fix It! Some iPhone 18 Pro Max Users Trapped in SOS Outage, Apple Says Replacement Needed
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 證實，少數使用美國電信商 AT&T 網路的 iPhone 18 Pro Max 用戶遇到行動網路連線故障，裝置失去訊號、無法撥打電話。蘋果已釋出系統與電信業者設定更新，協助預防問題發生，但因這項故障已失去服務的裝置，無法透過更新恢復連線，需安排換機。
《9to5Mac》週五 (2 日) 報導，受影響用戶的手機會顯示「SOS」，無法正常使用 AT&T 網路撥打電話、傳送簡訊或使用行動數據。
不過，蘋果強調，問題涉及少數用戶，並非所有使用 AT&T 網路的 iPhone 18 Pro Max 都受到影響。
蘋果向《9to5Mac》提供聲明指出，公司已確認這項連線問題，並於本週稍早釋出 iOS 27.0.1，強烈建議 iPhone 18 Pro Max 用戶更新。
同時，蘋果也於美國時間週五釋出電信業者設定更新，兩項更新搭配使用，旨在協助防止問題發生。
然而，蘋果表示，上述更新無法恢復已因這項問題失去行動網路服務的裝置。
受影響用戶需聯絡 Apple 支援或 AT&T，或前往 Apple Store、AT&T 門市尋求協助並安排換機。
電信業者設定更新將在未來 14 天內自動下載，用戶也可主動檢查更新。操作前，應先確認手機已連接 Wi-Fi 或行動網路，再依序開啟「設定」、「一般」、「關於本機」，並按照畫面指示安裝。
此次換機處理針對因上述 AT&T 連線問題失去服務的裝置。使用 AT&T 網路、且持續遇到 SOS 斷訊的用戶，應聯絡 Apple 或 AT&T 確認是否屬於此次故障，再安排後續處理。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) confirmed that a small number of iPhone 18 Pro Max users on the AT&T network in the United States have experienced mobile‑network connection failures, with devices losing signal and being unable to make calls. Apple has released a system and carrier‑settings update to help prevent the issue, but devices that have already lost service cannot be restored via the update and will need to be replaced.
9to5Mac reported on Friday the 2nd that the affected phones display “SOS” and cannot normally use the AT&T network to make calls, send texts, or use mobile data.
Apple emphasized that the problem affects only a small number of users and does not impact all iPhone 18 Pro Max devices on AT&T’s network.
Apple provided a statement to 9to5Mac saying the company has confirmed the connectivity issue and released iOS 27.0.1 earlier this week, strongly urging iPhone 18 Pro Max owners to update.
At the same time, Apple also rolled out a carrier‑settings update in the United States on Friday; using both updates together is intended to help prevent the problem from occurring.
However, Apple said the aforementioned updates cannot restore service to devices that have already lost mobile‑network connectivity because of the issue.
Affected users should contact Apple Support or AT&T, or visit an Apple Store or AT&T retail location for assistance and to arrange a replacement device.

The carrier‑settings update will automatically download within the next 14 days, and users can also check for it manually. Before proceeding, they should ensure the phone is connected to Wi‑Fi or cellular data, then go to Settings → General → About and follow the on‑screen instructions to install.

The replacement program applies to devices that have lost service due to the AT&T connectivity issue. Users on AT&T who continue to see the SOS outage should contact Apple or AT&T to confirm whether their device is covered by this fault and arrange the next steps.

items.title: 9月就業僅增2.9萬人 Fed可能放緩升息？Hammack：不急著決定下一步
items.title_en: September Jobs Up Only 29,000; Fed May Slow Rate Hikes? Hammack: No Rush to Decide Next Move
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁、2026年FOMC票委Hammack周五(2日)表示,聯準會在決定下一步貨幣政策前仍有充足時間評估最新經濟數據,暗示即使9月就業報告明顯疲弱,決策官員仍不急於在10月底的政策會議上採取行動。
Hammack接受PBS NewsHour訪問時表示,9月非農就業數據雖然表面上相當疲弱,但整體仍符合近期美國就業市場的發展趨勢。美國勞工部當天公布,9月非農就業人口僅增加2.9萬人,遠低於經濟學家預期的約9萬人,失業率則由8月的4.1%升至4.2%。
Hammack指出,如果拉長觀察時間,過去12個月美國平均每月新增就業約4.1萬人,大致符合她對維持勞動市場穩定所需的「損益平衡」就業增幅估計。因此,她認為最新數據並未完全改變對就業市場的判斷,而是延續近期招聘速度放緩的趨勢。
她表示,聯準會在10月底的下一次政策會議前仍會取得更多經濟資訊,因此現在仍有時間判斷最合適的貨幣政策立場。聯準會下一次聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)會議預定於10月27日至28日舉行。
聯準會9月會議已將聯邦基金利率目標區間上調25個基點至3.75%至4%,並在最新經濟預測中暗示今年底前可能再升息一次。不過,近期多名聯準會官員表示,沒有必要急於在10月會議立即再次升息,決策仍將取決於後續通膨、就業及經濟活動數據。
Hammack長期以來是聯準會內部較早主張升息以抑制通膨的官員之一。她此前多次表示,美國通膨仍高於聯準會2%的長期目標,如果價格壓力沒有進一步降溫,貨幣政策可能需要維持限制性立場,甚至進一步升息。Hammack 是2026年的FOMC票委，而且是有投票權的成員。
她9月25日曾表示,美國通膨持續高於目標超過5年,最大的風險之一是民眾逐漸形成接受高物價的通膨心態。她當時指出,聯準會需要確保政策維持在足夠限制性的水準,以推動通膨回到2%目標。
不過,最新就業數據讓聯準會面臨更加複雜的政策取捨。9月新增就業2.9萬人,不僅遠低於市場預期,8月新增就業人數也遭下修。失業率從4.1%升至4.2%,顯示勞動市場降溫程度正在加深。
市場因此大幅降低10月升息的預期。利率期貨數據顯示,截至周五,投資人預期聯準會10月會議升息的機率已降至不到20%,低於數據公布前的逾25%。市場同時下調12月升息押注,但仍認為今年底前再次升息存在相當可能性,12月升息機率仍接近90%。
政策預期的變化反映聯準會目前面臨兩項相互牽制的風險。一方面,通膨仍高於2%目標,能源價格上升以及地緣政治衝突可能進一步推升價格壓力；另一方面,如果聯準會持續升息或讓利率在高檔維持過久,則可能加劇就業市場降溫並對經濟活動造成壓力。
近期能源價格成為聯準會評估通膨的重要變數。伊朗戰事及中東能源供應受到干擾後,油價明顯上升,可能透過汽油、運輸及生產成本向其他商品與服務傳導。聯準會官員因此必須判斷近期通膨升溫究竟是短期能源衝擊,還是會進一步擴散至更廣泛的核心價格。
聯準會主席Kevin Warsh近期並未明確透露下一次升息的時間,但曾表示,如果政策制定者無法確認潛在通膨正以足夠速度朝2%目標下降,聯準會仍有進一步工作的必要。
紐約聯準銀行總裁John Williams本周也表示,政策官員目前沒有立即升息的急迫性,需要先觀察更多數據,但他仍認為今年底前再次升息具有合理性。聯準會副主席Philip Jefferson則表示,未來任何政策調整都應根據數據趨勢、經濟前景及風險平衡作出判斷,決策官員可能需要更多時間。
目前聯準會政策利率已處於3.75%至4%的區間,高於今年稍早的水準。9月會議公布的預測顯示,多數官員仍認為今年底前需要進一步收緊政策,但最新就業數據使10月立即升息的可能性明顯降低。
對Hammack而言,9月就業數據並不足以單獨決定政策方向。她強調,在10月27日至28日會議前仍有大量資料可供分析,包括通膨、就業及其他經濟活動指標。聯準會將在取得更多數據後,再決定如何在抑制通膨與維持就業市場穩定之間取得平衡。
市場目前因此將焦點轉向接下來公布的通膨數據及聯準會9月會議紀要。若通膨持續高於預期,政策官員可能重新提高對年底升息的支持；若就業市場進一步惡化,則可能增加聯準會暫緩升息的理由。10月底會議前的數據走向,將成為決定聯準會今年最後一次政策調整時機的關鍵。
paras_en: Federal Reserve (Fed) Cleveland Fed President and 2026 FOMC voting member Hammack said on Friday the Fed still has ample time to assess the latest economic data before deciding its next monetary policy step, suggesting that even with a clearly weak September jobs report, policymakers are not in a hurry to act at the policy meeting at the end of October.

In an interview with PBS NewsHour, Hammack noted that while September non‑farm payrolls look weak on the surface, they are still consistent with the recent trend in the U.S. labor market. The Labor Department reported that non‑farm employment rose by only 29,000 jobs in September, far below economists’ estimate of about 90,000, and the unemployment rate rose from 4.1% in August to 4.2%.

Hammack pointed out that over the past 12 months the U.S. has added an average of roughly 41,000 jobs per month, which roughly matches her estimate of the “break‑even” hiring pace needed to keep the labor market stable. Therefore, she believes the latest data does not fundamentally change her view of the labor market, but rather continues the recent slowdown in hiring speed.

She said the Fed will obtain more economic information before its next policy meeting at the end of October, so there is still time now to determine the most appropriate monetary‑policy stance. The next Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting is scheduled for October 27‑28.

The Fed’s September meeting raised the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%‑4.0% and, in its latest economic projections, hinted at a possible additional hike before the end of the year. However, several Fed officials recently have said there is no need to rush into another hike at the October meeting; the decision will depend on subsequent inflation, employment and activity data.

Hammack has long been one of the Fed’s earlier voices advocating rate hikes to curb inflation. She has repeatedly said U.S. inflation remains above the Fed’s 2% long‑run target and, if price pressures do not ease further, policy may need to stay restrictive or even tighten further. Hammack is a voting member of the 2026 FOMC.

On September 25 she warned that U.S. inflation has stayed above target for more than five years, and one of the biggest risks is that the public gradually becomes accustomed to high‑price inflation. She said the Fed must keep policy sufficiently restrictive to bring inflation back to the 2% goal.

Nevertheless, the latest jobs data complicates the Fed’s policy calculus. September’s addition of 29,000 jobs was far below expectations, and August’s job gains were also revised down. The unemployment rate’s rise from 4.1% to 4.2% shows a deepening cooling of the labor market.

As a result, markets have sharply trimmed expectations for an October hike. Futures data showed that by Friday investors’ probability of a rate increase at the October meeting had fallen to under 20%, down from more than 25% before the data release. The market also lowered its December hike bets, though it still sees a fairly high chance—near 90%—of another hike before year‑end.

The shift in policy expectations reflects two opposing risks the Fed now faces. On one hand, inflation remains above the 2% target, with rising energy prices and geopolitical tensions potentially adding further price pressure; on the other hand, continued tightening or keeping rates high for too long could further cool the labor market and weigh on economic activity.

Recent energy price movements have become a key variable in the Fed’s inflation assessment. After the Iran conflict and disruptions to Middle‑East energy supplies, oil prices rose noticeably, potentially passing through higher gasoline, transportation and production costs to other goods and services. Fed officials therefore must judge whether the recent inflation uptick is a short‑term energy shock or could spread to broader core prices.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has not explicitly indicated the timing of the next hike, but he has said that if policymakers cannot confirm that underlying inflation is falling toward the 2% goal at a sufficient pace, further action may be needed.

New York Fed President John Williams said this week that policymakers do not feel an immediate urgency to raise rates and need to observe more data, though he still believes a year‑end hike remains reasonable. Vice‑Chair Philip Jefferson added that any future policy adjustment should be based on data trends, economic outlook and risk balance, and that officials may need more time.

The Fed’s policy rate is currently in the 3.75%‑4.0% range, higher than earlier this year. The September projections showed most officials still thought further tightening would be required before year‑end, but the latest jobs data has markedly reduced the odds of an immediate October hike.

For Hammack, September’s jobs numbers alone are insufficient to dictate policy direction. She emphasized that a large amount of data—including inflation, employment and other activity indicators—will be available for analysis before the October 27‑28 meeting. The Fed will decide how to balance inflation control with labor‑market stability after gathering more information.

Markets have now shifted focus to upcoming inflation releases and the Fed’s September meeting minutes. If inflation stays above expectations, officials may renew support for a year‑end hike; if the labor market worsens further, they may find more reason to pause. The data trajectory before the end‑October meeting will be pivotal in timing the Fed’s final policy move of the year.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元連續第3周上漲 美債殖利率與Fed鷹派立場支撐
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Rises for Third Consecutive Week, U.S. Treasury Yields and Fed Hawkish Stance Provide Support
paras: 美元周五(2日)下跌，但仍連續第4周兌歐元走升。在歐洲政府公債遭遇拋售、以及市場預期聯準會(Fed)將維持鷹派升息立場的背景下，美國公債殖利率維持高檔，為美元提供支撐。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報101.88，仍連續第3周上漲。
美國公布9月就業成長低於經濟學家預期、失業率小幅升至4.2%後，美元近期部分漲幅有所收斂。10年期美國公債殖利率也在數據公布後下滑，隨後回升5.14個基點至5.285%。
儘管如此，美元仍受到多項因素支撐，包括美國公債殖利率維持在數十年高點附近、部分歐洲國家財政前景的疑慮升溫，以及油價上漲。原油價格走高促使部分投資人降低對主要能源進口國貨幣的曝險，包括歐元與日元。
歐元對美元上漲0.13%，至1.12580美元。歐元兌美元連續第4周下跌，創下2025年5月中旬以來最長連續周跌勢。
野村G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning表示，「如果把這些就業數據放在一起看，我認為這其實是一組相當理想的金髮女孩(Goldilocks)數據：經濟活動仍相當具韌性，但並未產生明顯的通膨壓力。」
他表示，「從整體經濟角度來看，這是個不錯的背景。對整體風險資產及高Beta貨幣而言，這應該是相對有利的數據。這對聯準會利率定價的影響可能也不大，但至少降低了聯準會是否會在10月再次升息的尾部風險。」
美國央行在9月政策會議結束後升息，並釋放進一步升息的訊號。儘管美國總統川普一再要求降低借貸成本，聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)仍重申貨幣政策的獨立性。市場對此做出反應，提高了對聯準會進一步緊縮政策的押注。
根據CME Group的FedWatch工具，交易員目前預期聯準會本月稍晚維持利率不變的機率為86%，高於一周前的36%。
美元兌瑞郎下跌0.30%，至0.8285瑞郎。
美元兌日元也下跌0.15%，至每美元157.81日元，但仍連續第3周上漲。
歐洲市場的擔憂
歐洲國家周五同意釋放柴油庫存。美國總統川普此前曾施壓各國政府採取這項措施，希望壓低與伊朗戰爭相關、持續飆升的燃料價格。
未來幾個月歐元區通膨率可能進一步上升，使歐洲央行(ECB)面臨升息壓力。
近幾周，法國與義大利政府公債持續承受賣壓，市場預期政策利率將上升，加上2027年大選逼近、政治風險升高，使市場更加謹慎。法國10年期公債殖利率周四飆升至2002年以來最高水準。
周五，法國10年期公債殖利率相較避險性較高的德國公債殖利率溢價擴大至150個基點以上，創2011年底以來最高，因市場對法國財政狀況與政治動盪的擔憂加劇。
歐元兌瑞郎下跌0.15%，至0.9327瑞郎。
歐元兌日元則持平於177.67日元。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Friday (the 2nd) but still posted its fourth straight weekly gain against the euro. With European sovereign bonds under pressure and markets expecting the Federal Reserve to maintain a hawkish rate‑hike stance, U.S. Treasury yields stayed elevated, underpinning the greenback.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.1% to 101.88, marking a third consecutive week of rise.

After the U.S. reported September job growth below economists’ forecasts and a modest rise in the unemployment rate to 4.2%, the dollar’s recent gains moderated. The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield also fell after the data release, then rebounded 5.14 basis points to 5.285%.

Nevertheless, the dollar remains supported by several factors, including Treasury yields lingering near multi‑decade highs, growing doubts over the fiscal outlook of some European nations, and higher oil prices. Rising crude has prompted some investors to cut exposure to currencies of major energy‑importing countries, such as the euro and the yen.
The euro rose 0.13% against the dollar to $1.12580. The euro‑dollar pair has now slipped for four straight weeks, the longest weekly decline streak since mid‑May 2025.

Nomura G10 FX strategy head Dominic Bunning said, “If you look at these employment numbers together, I think they actually represent a fairly Goldilocks set of data: economic activity remains quite resilient, yet there’s no clear inflationary pressure.”

He added, “From an overall economic perspective, that’s a decent backdrop. For risk assets and high‑beta currencies, it should be relatively favourable. The impact on Fed rate pricing may be limited, but at least it reduces the tail‑risk of another Fed hike in October.”

The U.S. central bank raised rates after its September policy meeting and signaled the possibility of further hikes. Although President Trump repeatedly urged lower borrowing costs, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated the independence of monetary policy. Markets reacted by increasing bets on additional Fed tightening.
According to CME Group’s FedWatch tool, traders now assign an 86% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged later this month, up from 36% a week earlier.
The dollar fell 0.30% against the Swiss franc, to 0.8285 CHF per dollar.
The dollar also slipped 0.15% against the yen, to ¥157.81 per dollar, but still posted a third straight weekly gain.
European market concerns

European countries on Friday agreed to release diesel inventories. President Trump had previously pressured governments to take this step, hoping to curb fuel prices that have surged amid the war with Iran.
In the coming months, euro‑area inflation could rise further, putting pressure on the European Central Bank to hike rates.

In recent weeks, French and Italian sovereign bonds have faced sustained selling pressure as markets anticipate higher policy rates. With the 2027 election looming and political risk rising, investors have become more cautious. French 10‑year yields spiked on Thursday to their highest level since 2002.

On Friday, the spread between French 10‑year yields and the relatively safer German 10‑year yields widened to over 150 basis points, the widest since the end of 2011, reflecting heightened concerns over France’s fiscal health and political turmoil.
The euro fell 0.15% against the Swiss franc, to 0.9327 CHF per euro.
The euro was flat against the yen at ¥177.67 per euro.

items.title: 歐債疑慮引發避險潮 瑞士法郎再成為避險寵兒
items.title_en: European Debt Concerns Spark Safe‑Haven Rally, Swiss Franc Again a Safe‑Haven Darling
paras: 受法國債務狀況引發歐洲市場疑慮影響，瑞士法郎再度成為市場避險焦點。隨著投資人對法國在明年大選前遏止債務的能力產生疑慮，瑞郎兌歐元迎來自去年 4 月以來表現最佳的一周。雖然瑞郎先前因低利率與零殖利率特性而走勢疲軟，但鄰國動盪促使資金迅速回流。

市場數據與交易現況

數據顯示，瑞郎在短短兩天內暴漲約 1.8%，歐元兌瑞郎匯率於周五跌至約 0.93 的兩個月新低。
根據芝加哥商品交易所(CME Group)資料，周四的交易量約為今年平均水準的 4 倍。此外，選擇權定價顯示資金湧入瑞郎的速度創下四年多來新高，未來一年的看多情緒升至 3 月以來最高點。
瑞郎因與黃金的歷史聯繫，長期被視為市場劇烈拋售時的避風港；且瑞士利率極低，平時常被用作套利交易的融資貨幣。

專家觀點

對於此波強勁漲勢，荷蘭國際集團(ING)外匯策略師Francesco Pesole 表示：「當歐元區的債務風險驟升時，瑞郎總是首選的避險貨幣。」Pesole 與德國商業銀行外匯策略師Michael Pfister 均認為這波反彈令人意外，原先預估市場會等到明年法國與義大利大選前夕才有所反應。
彭博策略師Mark Cranfield分析，瑞郎短期利率雖處於負值區域，但作為總體對沖工具時有進一步走低的前例；相反地，市場對歐洲央行(ECB)升息的預期未能支撐歐元，反映出對政策失誤可能損害歐元的擔憂，歐元兌瑞郎恐才剛開始更深幅度的下探。
Pfister 補充指出，隨著各國公布 2027 年籌資計畫，財政健全度將受到嚴格審視，而瑞士較為平衡的預算將持續吸引投資人。他預測，瑞郎未來一年將再升值逾 2%，推動歐元兌瑞郎降至 0.91，他表示：「老實說，現在能躲避風險的地方已經不多了。」
paras_en: The Swiss franc has once again become the market’s safe‑haven focus as concerns over France’s debt situation ripple through European markets. With investors doubting France’s ability to curb its debt before next year’s election, the franc‑to‑euro pair posted its best week since April last year. Although the franc had previously been weak due to low rates and zero‑yield characteristics, turmoil in the neighboring country quickly drove funds back into it.
Market data and trading activity show the franc surged about 1.8% in just two days, and the euro‑to‑franc exchange rate fell to roughly 0.93 on Friday, a two‑month low.

According to CME Group data, Thursday’s trading volume was about four times the average for the year. Moreover, options pricing indicates that the speed of capital flowing into the franc hit a four‑year high, and bullish sentiment for the next 12 months rose to its strongest level since March.

The franc, historically linked to gold, has long been viewed as a safe haven during sharp market sell‑offs; Switzerland’s ultra‑low rates also make the currency a popular funding vehicle for arbitrage trades.

Expert view: ING foreign‑exchange strategist Francesco Pesole said, “When debt risk in the euro area spikes, the franc is always the top safe‑haven currency.” Both Pesole and German commercial bank FX strategist Michael Pfister said the rebound was surprising, as they had originally expected the market to wait until the run‑up to next year’s French and Italian elections to react.

Bloomberg strategist Mark Cranfield noted that while short‑term Swiss rates are in negative territory, there is precedent for the franc to fall further when used as a broad hedge. Conversely, market expectations of ECB rate hikes failed to support the euro, reflecting worries that policy missteps could damage the currency, and the euro‑to‑franc pair may only be beginning a deeper decline.

Pfister added that as countries release their 2027 financing plans, fiscal soundness will be scrutinized closely, and Switzerland’s relatively balanced budget will continue to attract investors. He predicts the franc will appreciate by more than 2% over the next year, pushing the euro‑to‑franc rate down to 0.91, and said, “Honestly, there aren’t many places to hide from risk anymore.”

items.title: 〈台幣〉亞幣轉強！逆勢翻升收31.83元 觀望美非農報告
items.title_en: TWD: Asian Currencies Strengthen! Defying Trend, Rises to 31.83, Awaiting US Nonfarm Payrolls
paras: 市場關注美國稍晚即將公布的非農就業數據，台北匯市整體交投轉趨冷清，新台幣兌美元今 (2) 日盤中一度貶破 31.9 元關卡，外資雙向進出，但整體亞幣偏升，尾盤在央行調節下，新台幣終場以31.83元作收，小升1.2分，為連 3 升，台北與元太外匯總成交值萎縮至 21.91 億美元。
台北股匯本周僅有四個交易日，由於美伊衝突未見緩解，使得美元本周較為強勢，新台幣兌美元累計貶值5分或0.16%，周線再度翻黑。
台股電子權值股今(2)日多無表態，早盤呈現震盪走勢，但被動元件、光通訊、PCB、矽晶圓等中小型股接棒演出，帶動大盤走揚，最高漲至48491.62點，距盤中歷史新高 48601.53 點僅差臨門一腳，終場漲 122.25 點，收 48475.74 點，仍寫收盤新高，成交量8981.74億元。外資今天買超台股 26.22 億元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 31.87 元，盤中一度貶近 1 角，最低來到 31.935 元，不過，為避免新台幣走勢與主要亞幣脫鉤太多，央行適時進場調節，帶動匯價由貶轉升，收在 31.83 元。
觀察主要貨幣今天表現，根據央行統計，韓元強升 1.13%，成為本日最強亞幣，日元亦勁揚 0.51%，星幣升值 0.15%，新台幣小升 0.04%，人民幣則因十一長假休市。
周三數據顯示，美國8月通膨增幅低於預期，且7月數據遭到下修，降低了市場對聯準會本月升息的預期。市場將焦點轉向美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 即將公布的 9 月非農就業報告，這將是Fed 評估下一步利率政策的重要依據。
paras_en: The market is focused on the U.S. non‑farm payroll data that will be released later today. Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market turned relatively quiet, and the New Taiwan dollar slipped below the 31.9 per USD mark during the session. Foreign investors were active on both sides, but overall Asian currencies were on the rise. In the final minutes, after central‑bank intervention, the TWD closed at 31.83 per USD, a modest gain of 0.12 and the third consecutive rise. The total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market shrank to $2.191 billion.

Taipei’s stock and FX market had only four trading days this week. Because the U.S.–Iran conflict showed no sign of easing, the dollar remained relatively strong, and the TWD/USD pair depreciated a cumulative 5 ticks, or 0.16%, turning the weekly chart back into the red.

Taiwan’s heavyweight electronic stocks gave little guidance today, with the early session showing a choppy range. However, small‑ and mid‑cap stocks in passive components, optical communications, PCBs and silicon wafers took the lead, lifting the index to a high of 48,491.62 points—just 110 points shy of the intraday record of 48,601.53. The market closed up 122.25 points at 48,475.74, still posting a new closing high, with a turnover of NT$898.174 billion. Foreign investors were net buyers of NT$2.622 billion of Taiwan equities today.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.87 per USD and fell nearly 0.10 during the session, reaching a low of 31.935. To prevent the TWD from drifting too far from the major Asian currencies, the central bank stepped in, turning the depreciation into appreciation and ending the day at 31.83.

Looking at the performance of major currencies today, central‑bank data show the Korean won surged 1.13%, making it the strongest Asian currency of the day. The Japanese yen also rose sharply by 0.51%, the Star coin appreciated 0.15%, the New Taiwan dollar edged up 0.04%, while the Chinese renminbi was closed for the National Day holiday.

Wednesday’s data showed that August U.S. inflation rose less than expected and July’s figures were revised lower, easing market expectations of a Fed rate hike this month. Attention now shifts to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics’ upcoming September non‑farm payroll report, which will be a key reference for the Fed’s next interest‑rate decision.

items.title: 川普憂弱勢日元衝擊美貿易 高市：日元低估本身就是問題
items.title_en: Trump Worried Weak Yen Threatens US Trade; Kōchi: Yen Undervaluation Is a Problem in Itself
paras: 日本首相高市早苗周四(1日)透露，她上個月在紐約與美國總統川普會談時，被告知日元疲弱正導致美國貿易面臨困境。
高市接受日本電視台(NTV)獨家專訪，被問到美日雙方是否就如何處理日元疲弱問題取得一致時，她說：「在日美領袖會談中，對方提到美國貿易因日元疲弱而面臨困難，我則回應，按照一般原則，日元被低估本身就是一個問題。」
高市並透露與財務大臣片山皐月對談時獲悉，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)曾表示，他理解日本政府的經濟政策，也沒有就政策方向提出任何要求。
她在周四晚間播出的專訪中說：「我們在繼續負責任且積極的財政政策下，追求強健經濟與永續財政的想法並沒有改變。」
川普政府近來罕見頻頻表達對日元疲弱的關切。貝森特多次暗示，日本銀行(央行，BOJ)應升息，以協助日元找到適當價位。他在德州一所大學演講時曾說，他對日本政策制定者接下來的行動「相當有把握」，甚至向投機客嗆聲「我是莊家」，要求他們押注日元貶值、與他對作。
先前日元兌美元貶至164附近之後，日美當局曾共同介入外匯市場，是雙方美日28年來首次聯手支撐日元。川普當時形容，這項干預是友誼的象徵。
日本官員通常會淡化美方言論對日本政策制定方面的影響。高市在專訪中避免對外匯市場做出具體評論，轉而談及她對經濟振興的願景，強調這將有助於支撐日元。
她說：「我們希望透過大膽投資風險管理與成長領域，提高日本潛在經濟成長率並強化供應能力，以實現強健經濟。我相信，提高日本經濟的競爭力，最終將有助於建立對日元的信心。」
paras_en: Japanese Prime Minister Naoto Kōchi said on Thursday (the 1st) that during her meeting with US President Donald Trump in New York last month, she was told that a weak yen is causing difficulties for US trade.

In an exclusive interview with Japan's NTV, when asked whether the US and Japan had reached a consensus on how to handle the weak yen, she said: “During the US‑Japan leaders’ talks, the US side mentioned that American trade is facing challenges because of the weak yen. I responded that, as a general principle, an undervalued yen is itself a problem.”

Kōchi also revealed that in a conversation with Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama she learned that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent had said he understands Japan’s economic policy and has not made any demands regarding its direction.
In the interview aired Thursday evening she said: “Our commitment to responsible and proactive fiscal policy, and our pursuit of a strong economy and sustainable finances, remains unchanged.”

The Trump administration has lately expressed unusually frequent concern over the weak yen. Bessent has repeatedly hinted that the Bank of Japan should raise rates to help the yen find an appropriate level. Speaking at a Texas university, he said he is “quite confident” about the next steps Japanese policymakers will take and even taunted speculators, saying “I’m the house” and urging them to bet on yen depreciation in line with his view.

After the yen fell to around 164 per dollar, US and Japanese authorities jointly intervened in the foreign‑exchange market – the first US‑Japan coordinated support for the yen in 28 years. Trump at the time described the intervention as a symbol of friendship.

Japanese officials usually downplay the impact of US statements on Japan’s policy‑making. In the interview Kōchi avoided specific comments on the FX market, instead discussing her vision for economic revitalisation and stressing that it would help support the yen.

She said: “We aim to boost Japan’s potential growth rate and strengthen supply capacity through bold investment, risk management and growth‑sector focus, to achieve a robust economy. I believe that enhancing Japan’s competitiveness will ultimately help build confidence in the yen.”

items.title: 東京9月核心CPI漲2.7%超預期 支持升息預期
items.title_en: Tokyo September Core CPI Rises 2.7% Beyond Expectations, Supporting Rate‑Hike Outlook
paras: 日本總務省公布9月東京都區部排除生鮮食品的核心消費者物價指數，年增率達2.7%，高於市場預期的2.3%至2.4%，為連續第4個月擴大增幅，並創下8個月來首次重返2%上方。排除生鮮食品與能源後的雙核心CPI年增率更攀升至3.0%。
由於東京數據為日本全國物價的先行指標，數據公布後日元應聲走強，美元兌日元匯率跌破158關卡。
總務省說明，本次物價推升主因包含幼兒托育免費效應減退、基本水費免費政策結束，以及連假效應拉高住宿與旅遊費用；此外，晶片價格上漲與AI需求帶動電腦等娛樂耐久財價格走高。
針對通膨動向，國際通貨研究所上席研究員久後翔太郎表示，雖然幼兒托育等特殊政策影響顯著，但「剔除一時性因素後，基底物價的上揚壓力持續增強並未改變」。他認為這將支持日本央行加快升息步調，年內再次升息「幾乎無庸置疑」，若日元急貶，甚至不排除於10月動手。
彭博經濟學資深經濟學家木村太郎則指出，數據超預期主要是政策因素推高，「物價基調並非驟然改變」。但他補充說明，能源價格上漲、日元貶值及人工成本增加正波及廣泛品項，基底通膨動能仍相當強勁。
日本央行已於9月會議將政策利率調升至1.25%，總裁植田和男先前強調政策進入「局面變化」，對進一步升息抱持正面態度。目前利率交換市場已幾乎完全預估12月前將再次升息。
paras_en: Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications reported that the core consumer price index for Tokyo’s metropolitan area in September, excluding fresh food, rose 2.7% year‑on‑year, above the market forecast of 2.3%‑2.4%. This marks the fourth consecutive month of accelerating growth and the first time in eight months that the rate has returned above 2%. The “double‑core” CPI, which also excludes energy, climbed to a 3.0% annual increase.
Because Tokyo’s data is seen as a leading indicator for Japan’s nationwide inflation, the yen strengthened after the release, with the dollar‑yen rate slipping below the 158 level.

The ministry explained that the price rise was driven mainly by the waning effect of free childcare for infants, the end of a policy providing free basic water, and a holiday‑related surge in accommodation and travel costs. In addition, higher chip prices and AI‑driven demand lifted the prices of computers and other entertainment‑durable goods.

Commenting on the inflation trend, senior researcher Shōtarō Kuho of the International Monetary Research Institute said that although special policies such as free childcare have a noticeable impact, “once temporary factors are stripped out, the upward pressure on underlying prices continues to intensify and has not changed.” He believes this will support the Bank of Japan in accelerating its rate‑hike pace, making another hike within the year “almost a certainty,” and if the yen were to depreciate sharply, a move as early as October cannot be ruled out.

Senior Bloomberg economist Taro Kimura noted that the data beating expectations was mainly due to policy‑related factors and that “the overall price trend has not suddenly shifted.” He added that rising energy prices, yen depreciation and higher labor costs are affecting a broad range of items, keeping core inflation momentum still very strong.

The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% at its September meeting. Governor Kazuo Ueda had previously emphasized that policy was entering a “changing landscape” and expressed a positive stance toward further hikes. The interest‑rate swap market now almost fully prices in another rate increase before December.

週四全英房屋抵押貸款協會調查英國9月房屋價格較前月跌0.2%及較上年同期降至0.8%，而且美國公債收益率攀升提振美元，引英鎊兌美元自1.3272高點下跌。隨著中東戰事持久導致油價每桶100美元以上恐帶來長期影響，並據S&P全球英國9月製造業PMI升至51.9及工廠投入成本漲幅為6月以來最大，但製造業產出增速創3月以來新低，而且英國央行(BOE)委員曼恩認為應對伊朗戰爭衝擊不果斷加劇政策不確定性，打擊英鎊兌美元至1.3177低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3185-1.3205，支撐於1.3070-90。

U.S. August inflation rose less than expected and July data were revised down, easing the urgency for the Federal Reserve to raise rates again this month. However, the ongoing Middle East war continues to push up global prices, driving U.S. 10‑year and 30‑year Treasury yields to fresh highs not seen since June 2007 and June 2002 respectively, supporting the dollar at a two‑month high on Thursday. In addition, S&P Global reported that Japan’s September manufacturing PMI fell to a six‑month low of 54.1, while the Bank of Japan’s short‑term business survey showed that large‑manufacturing firms’ confidence index for Q3 hit its highest level since March 2018 at +24. Conversely, the large non‑manufacturing confidence index slipped for the first time in five quarters to +35. Companies now expect consumer prices to rise an average 2.6% over the next year, lower than three months ago. The BOJ’s September meeting minutes reveal that most policymakers think rate hikes should accelerate, but two dovish members of the nine‑person policy board opposed a September increase. Markets think the BOJ may pause in October, a view that has weighed on the yen and pushed USD/JPY up from its low of 157.31.

A televised interview with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi showed her vowing to boost economic competitiveness to support the yen. Meanwhile, U.S. initial jobless claims fell to 197,000 and August construction spending rose 0.9% versus expectations. Even though S&P Global and the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) reported September U.S. manufacturing PMIs of 55.9 and 54.5 respectively, Fed Vice‑Chair Jefferson and Minneapolis Fed President Kashkari both said the Fed’s next move remains uncertain, keeping the dollar up to a high of 158.45 against the yen. Australian Bureau of Statistics data showed that a sharp rebound in data‑center equipment imports offset a strong rebound in gold exports, narrowing the August trade surplus to A$495 million, below expectations. Reports that China has halted fuel exports and the U.S. military has increased its presence in the Middle East have further battered the euro‑dollar pair, pulling it down to a low of 1.1214 ahead of the U.S. jobs report. items.title: Fed蘿根：至少應再升息2碼  並需連番升息來抵銷去年秋季降息
items.title_en: Fed Logan: At Least Two More Rate Hikes Needed, With Consecutive Increases to Counter Last Fall’s Cuts
paras: 達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根(Lorie Logan)週四(1日)表示，聯準會(Fed)至少應該再升息2碼(50個基點)。
她在一場演講中話道：「聯準會的政策立場一直偏離正軌，聯準會應該升息，目標至少為加50個基點。且至少需要進一步升息數次，才能抵銷去年秋季的降息，因為若無較高的利率，通膨無法達到聯準會2%目標。」
蘿根還表示，長債殖利率走高顯示市場參與者預期未來利率水準更高，她將密切關注美債殖利率走勢並評估其對經濟、融資成本和貨幣政策的影響。
她認為，長端殖利率上升未必只來自政策預期，也可能反映期限溢價走高。若投資人要求更高補償、期限溢價上升，會自然推高借貸成本，在一定程度上取代Fed緊縮，進而降低進一步升息的必要性。
但蘿根強調，Fed不會僅因長債殖利率上漲就預設行動，而會結合通膨、就業與金融環境判斷。
蘿根曾在2023年的演講中詳細介紹她所參考的各類美債市場模型。她表示，會持續觀察殖利率走勢以及經濟其他方面，以此判斷何種利率水準能對經濟形成一定抑制效果。
蘿根今年在聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)是擁有投票資格的決策官員，但作為地區聯準銀行總裁，她的言論仍被視為政策方向的重要參考。
paras_en: Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said on Thursday (the 1st) that the Federal Reserve should raise rates by at least two more increments, equivalent to 50 basis points.

In her speech she said, “The Fed’s policy stance has been off track; the Fed should raise rates, targeting at least an additional 50 basis points. Several more hikes will be needed to offset the rate cuts made last autumn, because without higher rates inflation cannot reach the Fed’s 2% goal.”

Logan also noted that rising long‑term bond yields indicate market participants expect higher future rates, and she will closely monitor U.S. Treasury yield movements and assess their impact on the economy, financing costs, and monetary policy.

She argued that the rise in long‑end yields may not stem solely from policy expectations; it could also reflect a higher term premium. If investors demand greater compensation and term premiums rise, borrowing costs will naturally increase, partially substituting for Fed tightening and reducing the need for further hikes.
Nonetheless, Logan emphasized that the Fed will not act solely on higher long‑term yields; decisions will be based on a combination of inflation, employment, and financial‑market conditions.

Logan previously detailed the various Treasury‑market models she follows in a 2023 speech, saying she will continue to watch yield trends and other economic indicators to gauge what level of rates can exert a sufficient restraining effect on the economy.

Logan is a voting member of the Federal Open Market Committee this year, and although she serves as a regional Fed president, her comments are still regarded as an important reference for the direction of policy.
